plain: Steven Greer, a man who has long campaigned for UFO secrets to be made public, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that in the early 2020s he met David Grusch while Grusch was still an undercover operative and no one knew who he was. Grusch is a former intelligence official who later spoke out publicly about hidden UFO programmes. Greer says he was providing information to Grusch's own bosses, which would place Greer close to the people behind the later disclosures.
